correctness.rationale: Six codewords must cover 36 ordered two-letter descendants, while each length-four word has at most six. With equality every selected word has six distinct descendants and supplies exactly one diagonal pair; hence one per letter, necessarily (a,b,c,a) with a,b,c distinct. Pair coverage splits 15 undirected edges into 12 bidirectional spokes and 3 singly-oriented edges. The three single edges must form a matching; contraction forces a directed cycle among three matched groups. Each group has two complementary orderings, giving 15 matchings times 2 cycle orientations times 2^3 internal choices=240. Parity of the internal ordering bits under local pair swaps creates exactly two alphabet-relabeling orbits of 120; reversal switches them. Independent exact-cover enumeration from 20 feasible words per diagonal center returned 240.

evidence: Theorem establishes Spec(6,4,2)={6} union [8,10], not 240 labeled size-six codes or two relabeling orbits.
